name: merge_remediation
description: Attempts a worktree merge up to three times. Each conflict attempt invokes the merge resolver agent once, then retries the merge. Always returns final merge evidence.

repoPath.description: Absolute path to the integration git checkout that group branches are merged into.

groupIds.description: Group IDs to merge, in order (each resolves to a group branch). Accepts a comma-separated string or an array of strings; no groups are merged if omitted.

modelBuilder.description: Model identifier passed to the conflict-resolution agent; empty string defers to the agent's default.

maxBudgetUsd.description: USD budget ceiling per conflict-resolution agent call.

preflight.description: If true, first prove the complete ordered merge set in a disposable worktree so a conflict is never discovered in the supplied integration checkout.

modelProfile.description: Named model-policy profile to select; empty string defers to the policy's default profile.

modelPolicy.description: Inline model policy document merged on top of the bundled and repository policies.

modelPolicySource.description: Label recorded for the inline modelPolicy's provenance.

modelPolicySha256.description: Expected canonical SHA-256 of the inline modelPolicy; resolution fails if it does not match.

modelsConfig.description: Relative path inside the worktree to a repository model policy file, overriding the default location.

modelOverrides.description: Per-role overrides merged on top of the selected model profile's roles.

mergeState.description: Final routable verdict from the last merge attempt: 'merged' only when every branch merged cleanly or was successfully conflict-resolved.

merge.description: Full result of the last merge attempt made by the retry loop.

merged.description: Branches merged cleanly with no conflicts.

conflicts.description: Branches that produced merge conflicts, regardless of whether they were later resolved.

resolved.description: Conflicted branches the agent successfully resolved and committed.

unresolved.description: Branches left unresolved after all resolution attempts, or that failed to merge outright.

errors.description: Merge failures with no conflict markers: absent branch, dirty-index guard, hook failure, etc.

tokenUsed.description: Total LLM tokens consumed across this attempt's conflict-resolution calls.

costUsd.description: Total USD cost of this attempt's conflict-resolution calls.

commit.description: HEAD commit SHA of repoPath after this merge attempt.

attempts.description: Number of merge attempts the retry loop executed (up to 3).
